paragraphs: The Nasdaq enters the pre-market with a cautiously negative setup: the Nasdaq Score is -30/100. Consolidation Risk is 12/100 (Low).

Nasdaq internals are mixed, so directional confirmation is incomplete (semiconductors mixed, mega-caps negative, breadth mixed).
